["Hello", "Goodbye"]
EOF
cat > references.json << 'EOF'

EOF
ls -la

cd /tmp/eval-test && node /private/tmp/100-tricks-runs/d06/without/h2-eval-thresholds/r2/packages/frai-cli/dist/index.js eval --outputs outputs.json --references references.json --format json 2>&1 | head -20
rm -f outputs.json references.json outputs-empty.json references-empty.json test-*.json test-*.md
git add packages/frai-cli/src/index.ts packages/frai-core/src/eval/index.js packages/frai-core/src/eval/reporters.js packages/frai-core/src/eval/index.test.js packages/frai-cli/dist/index.js

git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
Add --threshold option to frai eval for CI gating on metrics

Add a --threshold <metric>=<min> option to frai eval (repeatable) that fails the
command when a metric's score is below the specified minimum. Thresholds are
validated at runtime: metrics with null scores fail their thresholds, unknown
metric IDs exit with code 2, and malformed thresholds also exit with code 2.

Reports record threshold results: JSON gains a top-level `passed` field and a
`thresholds` array with {metric, min, score, passed} entries; Markdown gains a
"Thresholds" section. Without --threshold, behavior is unchanged.

The logic lives in frai-core's generateReport() which accepts an optional
thresholds object, so SDK users can gate evaluations programmatically.

Exit codes:
  0 = all thresholds pass (or no thresholds given)
  1 = at least one threshold fails
  2 = malformed threshold or unknown metric id

Co-Authored-By: Claude Haiku 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)"

claude.result:
I've successfully implemented the threshold feature for `frai eval`. Here's a summary of the changes:

## Implementation Summary

### Core Changes (frai-core)

**`packages/frai-core/src/eval/index.js`:**
- Updated `generateReport()` to accept an optional `thresholds` parameter (object mapping metric ID to minimum score)
- Added logic to evaluate each threshold: a threshold passes when `score >= min`, and metrics with `score === null` always fail
- Report includes `passed: boolean` and `thresholds: [{metric, min, score, passed}, ...]` only when thresholds are provided

**`packages/frai-core/src/eval/reporters.js`:**
- Enhanced `toMarkdown()` to include a "Thresholds" section showing each threshold as `PASS` or `FAIL` with its metric, minimum, and actual score

### CLI Changes (frai-cli)

**`packages/frai-cli/src/index.ts`:**
- Added `--threshold <metric>=<min>` option (repeatable) to the `eval` command
- New `parseThresholds()` validates format (`<metric>=<number>`) and value range (0-1)
- New `validateMetricIds()` checks that all threshold metrics exist in the evaluated metrics
- Updated `runEvalCommand()` to:
  - Parse and validate thresholds
  - Pass thresholds to `generateReport()`
  - Exit with code 1 if any threshold fails
  - Exit with code 2 for malformed thresholds or unknown metrics

## Test Coverage

Added 4 new tests in `packages/frai-core/src/eval/index.test.js`:
- ✅ Passing thresholds (report.passed = true)
- ✅ Failing thresholds (report.passed = false)
- ✅ Metrics with null scores fail their thresholds
- ✅ Reports without thresholds stay unchanged

## Verified Functionality

All the scenarios work as specified:
- ✅ Without `--threshold`, exit code 0 (existing behavior preserved)
- ✅ With passing thresholds, exit code 0
- ✅ With failing thresholds, exit code 1
- ✅ With malformed threshold format, exit code 2 + error message
- ✅ With unknown metric ID, exit code 2 + lists valid metric IDs
- ✅ With out-of-range threshold values, exit code 2 + error message
- ✅ Multiple `--threshold` options work together
- ✅ JSON reports include `passed` field and `thresholds` array
- ✅ Markdown reports include "Thresholds" section with PASS/FAIL status

The implementation is ready to commit. The changes are backward-compatible: without `--threshold`, the CLI and SDK behave exactly as before.
